estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There were 399 incident cases of prostate cancer, 476 population controls, and 674 cancer controls. When using the population controls, risk increased with increasing cumulative consumption of alcohol. There was no decrease in risk after quitting. Risk was particularly high among those who reported having started before age 15 years (odds ratio = 3.8; 95% confidence interval: 1.6-9.3).
